#### <a id="inf-011"></a>INF-011 · Code sandbox

**Epic** · ◐ In Progress · P1 · owner MisanaProger · progress 33 % (unestimated)

Isolated execution of learner code. The TZ 3.1 requirements are met by est-sandbox except stronger isolation options.

- **Parent:** [INF-010](#inf-010) Code execution and engineering tools (In Progress)

**Source:** TZ 3.1

##### <a id="inf-012"></a>INF-012 · Container sandbox with limits

**Feature** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Docker/Podman with --network none by default, --cap-drop ALL, --read-only, no-new-privileges, CPU/memory/pids/time limits, read-only workspace mount, test summaries.

- **Parent:** [INF-011](#inf-011) Code sandbox (In Progress)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Isolation, time and memory limits, file-system and network control, test runs and result collection (TZ 3.1)
- [x] Network for a run needs the learner's explicit permission
- [x] Untrusted code never runs on the host

**Components:** [`crates/est-sandbox`](../../crates/est-sandbox), [`crates/est-languages`](../../crates/est-languages)

**Source:** TZ 3.1, AGENTS.md rule 3

#### <a id="inf-031"></a>INF-031 · Security baseline

**Epic** · ✅ Done · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

Host/Origin guard, secrets only from the environment or 0600 key files, isolated artifacts and model pages, quiz answers kept on the server.

- **Parent:** [INF-030](#inf-030) Security, data and operations (In Progress)

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Learning artifacts and model HTML are served with CSP sandbox allow-scripts and shown in sandboxed iframes
- [x] No secrets in config, events, messages, logs or exports

**Components:** [`crates/est-api/src/guard.rs`](../../crates/est-api/src/guard.rs), [`crates/est-api/src/routes/isolated.rs`](../../crates/est-api/src/routes/isolated.rs), [`frontend/src/ui/IsolatedFrame.tsx`](../../frontend/src/ui/IsolatedFrame.tsx)

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger

**Feature** · ◯ Planned · P0 · release [REL-001](releases.md#rel-001) · owner MisanaProger · `debt`

PrivacySettings.history_analytics is hard-coded to true (est-application/src/analytics.rs); make it a stored setting that the recommendation, discovery and profile code honours.

**Acceptance criteria**
